CommonMark Java and GFM tables, vendored for the Chromium build
============================================================

Owner:         Atlassian Pty Ltd and the CommonMark Java contributors
Licence:       BSD-2-Clause; LICENSE is copied unchanged from META-INF/LICENSE.txt
Source:        Maven Central, org.commonmark:commonmark:0.30.0 and
               org.commonmark:commonmark-ext-gfm-tables:0.30.0
Version owner: gradle/libs.versions.toml, indexed by TOOLCHAIN.md
Recorded:      2026-09-09

Both artifacts ship and are byte-identical to Maven Central. Their published
SHA-256 sidecars were verified when downloaded. These overlay-owned prebuilts
follow the Dagger integration pattern: no new upstream Android dependency or
fork-unwritable CIPD package is introduced. The two builds use the same version.
The tables extension depends only on core; core has no runtime dependencies.

Upstream release:
https://github.com/commonmark/commonmark-java/releases/tag/commonmark-parent-0.30.0

TaffyGo owns updates and vulnerability tracking for these artifacts. The parser
has bounded input and nesting; parsing is off the UI thread. The native renderer
does not interpret HTML or fetch images embedded in model output.

bytes_commonmark_ext_gfm_tables_0_30_0_jar=24485
